capabilities: Fetch Wordnik data for a search term
Fetch data for the active note title
Paste definitions and related words at the cursor
Limit the number of definitions inserted
extras: Users must obtain their own Wordnik API key; setup and customization instructions are in the README.
intentEvidence: This is a plugin is a modified version of the Obsidian Wikipedia Plugin
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up dictionary data from Wordnik and insert it into notes.

relations.evidence: modified version of the Obsidian Wikipedia Plugin by Jonathan Miller

summary: Wordnik integration that fetches word definitions and related data and pastes them into a note.
